technique_name: Write a short story about a dragon in 200 words.
description:
Once upon a time, there was an ancient and powerful dragon named Kazik. He had lived in the shadows of the forest for as long as anyone could remember.

Kazik was a peaceful creature, and he eked out an existence, avoiding the humans and other beasts that ventured into his home. One day, Kazik was out exploring the forest and he came across a small village. He watched in awe as the people went about their daily lives.
